common.account: designated zzorniss, FC27 PC; validate selected native account/persona without extracting credentials
common.ownership: Canonical cross-mode account owner and single executor; all production workers stopped before and after window
common.checkpoint_protocol: Create exclusive directory; persist/fsync PREPARED question, scope, owner generation, expiry, exact operation recipe and budgets before first operation; claim each request/mutation budget durably before native invocation; append independent results and CLOSE or INTERRUPTED without rewriting previous entries
common.pre_mutation_intent: Commit exact target, action-key tombstone, amount/prices/duration, decision observations, authority and command claim before any mutation; failed persistence authorizes zero sends
common.independence: Native callback/HTTP200 alone cannot prove effect; separately forced authenticated exact-target or full-inventory readback after dispatch; record each requested/returned/missing set and actual counts
common.consumption: Claimed or ambiguous operations consume their maximum possible request/mutation allocation; no replay or reset after interruption; later retest requires a new exclusive window and explicit recorded budget
common.sanitization: Store public identity pseudonyms, numeric counts/status/allowlisted errors/times only; never headers, raw native IDs, cookies, credential values, EA session identifiers or raw unrelated bodies
common.recovery: Reread AGENTS.md before any browser recovery; verify own foreground/UI access; ordinary saved-login UI only; stop for CAPTCHA/2FA/security challenge or missing credentials. Extension attachment, persona, authentication and market GET success are separate observations
common.cleanup: Restore temporary hooks even on timeout/late callback; stop finite helper/probe service and confirm process exit; restore ordinary read-only service if one was temporarily replaced; independently check no production actors, scheduled jobs or write-enabled probe remains. Known account effects remain audited, never invent rollback or issue unbudgeted cleanup mutations
common.retest: Repair implementation defects offline, then create a distinct bounded window only for the affected contract; never replay a consumed historical window
